subject: OrchidHealth switch economics: spot-check & packaging options
messages:
From: Anil Desai <anil.desai@orchidhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick economics check for RFP shortlist

Karthik —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We're finishing a two-vendor shortlist and our finance team asked for a quick spot-check of swap economics and packaging options before we proceed to legal.

Attached is a short RFP excerpt (scope, peak QPS, retention) — could you sketch high-level replacement assumptions (cost delta, onboarding credit, any Egress considerations) and two packaging sketches we could share internally? We need it by end-of-day tomorrow if possible.

Thanks,
Anil

Attachment: RFP_Technical_Scope.pdf (PDF, 74KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Anil Desai <anil.desai@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick economics check for RFP shortlist

Anil —

Appreciate the materials. High-level spot-check below (short summary for your finance/procurement):

Summary assumptions
- Current vendor baseline: inferred from RFP peak QPS and retention: ~1.1M tokens/day
- Typical inference mix: 75% text-gen, 25% embeddings/rerank (we can refine with logs)
- Onboarding estimate: 2 engineer-weeks (can compress with our migration playbook)

Three packaging sketches (price-forwards, simplified)
1) Consumption-first (low commitment)
   - Unit price: $0.008 / 1k tokens (approx)
   - No minimum commit; 30% pilot credit for first 90 days
   - Benefit: lowest up-front; slightly higher unit price

2) Committed throughput (recommended for predictability)
   - 12-month reserved capacity covering ~70% of baseline
   - Effective unit price: $0.0055 / 1k tokens
   - Includes onboarding credit equivalent to first month of committed spend

3) Hybrid (phased commit + runway credit)
   - 6-month term with step-up commit; onboarding stipend + migration engineering hours
   - Includes a one-time migration credit ($25k) if signed within 30 days

Operational caveats
- Egress: if you have cross-cloud egress at scale, add egress pass-through in the SOW
- Model variant parity: we can guarantee functional parity on our curated catalog but will need a quick eval on a small prompt set (recommended as part of pilot)

I'll attach a brief terms spreadsheet with the above bullets for your internal review. If procurement wants a formal price match request, we can prepare a short commercial sideletter; legal will need a run at SLA/indemnities.

Next step: Do you want the committed quote in a redlined XLS or a short one-pager? Happy to sync with procurement — looping Marissa who can approve exception thresholds.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Spotcheck_Terms.xlsx (Excel, 12KB)
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@orchidhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Anil Desai <anil.desai@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 14:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick economics check for RFP shortlist

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. A few clarifying procurement questions before we escalate to legal:
- For the committed throughput option, can you confirm how burst above commit is billed and whether we get any free burst buffer?
- The migration credit—does that require a minimum commit or can it be applied against professional services for pilot scope?
- Can you provide an estimate for expected latency SLO impact if we move to a smaller quantized runtime (we assume cost-sensitive inference for a subset of endpoints)

If you can answer inline, that'll help speed approvals. We have an internal deadline Monday to recommend a vendor to our CFO.

Best,
Maya
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick economics check for RFP shortlist

Maya —

Happy to confirm a few things; quick replies below and copying Karthik for any commercial specifics:

- Burst billing: committed pools include a configurable burst allowance (default 15% of committed throughput) billed at the committed unit price for the burst up to the allowance; beyond that, pay-as-you-go unit pricing applies.
- Migration credit: credit can be applied either as dollar credit against committed spend or as PS hours — we can structure based on your preference. No additional minimum beyond the term required for the chosen packaging.
- Latency SLO / quantization: we support int8 and 4-bit paths on many models. For the subset you mentioned, expect a median latency delta of ~10-25ms at 512-token context when moving to quantized paths; we'd validate on your representative prompt set during pilot. If low-latency is required, we can reserve dedicated capacity instead of shared quantized pools.

Karthik — if you can produce the committed quote (per-month numbers + burst allowance) and a short pilot validation plan, we can get this to legal and procurement today.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@orchidhealth.com>, Anil Desai <anil.desai@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2028 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick economics check for RFP shortlist

Maya / Anil —

Attached is a short committed quote and a 3-step pilot plan (validation prompts, latency checks, runbook for KV cache handoff). Key commercials summarized:

- 12-month reserved (70% baseline): $42,000/mo effective (~$0.0054 / 1k tokens)
- Burst allowance: 15% at committed rate; overage at $0.0075 / 1k tokens
- Migration credit: $25,000 applied as either PS hours or first-month credit (you choose)
- Pilot: 2-week prompt validation + perf run; deliverables: benchmark report, go/no-go checklist

DocuSign link for the sideletter will follow once procurement confirms the packaging. Connor (copied) will coordinate the legal SOW and expedite the DocuSign packet if you tell us which packaging you prefer.

Attached: Committed_Quote_ORCH.xlsx (Excel, 9KB)

Thanks — we can jump on a 30-min call Monday morning if that helps your internal timeline.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
